responsibility: Acts as the declarative source of truth for x86 builtin type signatures. It enumerates primitive, vector, pointer, and function-type descriptors used by the i386 builtin subsystem, which the generator script turns into compact enums and tables; in practice this file defines the type vocabulary and builtin function prototypes consumed by i386-builtins.h and i386-builtins.cc when declaring GCC’s x86 builtins.
same_name_distinction: Unlike i386-builtin-types.awk, which is the generator, this file is the declarative source data: it enumerates primitive, vector, pointer, and function-type descriptors that the awk script turns into generated builtin-type tables.
